description: Defines the interface and data structures for the Network Error Logging (NEL) service, including policies, request details, and storage mechanisms.

classes.name: net::NetworkErrorLoggingService
classes.description: Interface for the Network Error Logging service, managing policies, error reports, and storage.

classes.name: net::NetworkErrorLoggingService::PersistentNelStore
classes.description: Abstract class for persistent storage of NEL policies.

classes.name: net::NelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key representing a (NIK, origin) pair for NEL policies.

classes.name: net::WildcardNelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key for wildcard policies applicable to a domain and its subdomains.

classes.name: net::NelPolicy
classes.description: Represents a NEL policy set by an origin, including expiration, report endpoint, and fractions.

classes.name: net::RequestDetails
classes.description: Contains details of a network error for reporting purposes.

classes.name: net::SignedExchangeReportDetails
classes.description: Contains details of a signed exchange report.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the NEL service with optional persistent store.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::OnHeader
methods.description: Processes a received NEL header for a given origin and network anonymization key.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::OnRequest
methods.description: Queues a network error report based on request details.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes browsing data for origins matching a filter.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::SetReportingService
methods.description: Sets the reporting service used for sending reports.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns a value representing current policies and status.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::GetPolicyKeysForTesting
methods.description: Returns current policy keys for testing.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::GetPersistentNelStoreForTesting
methods.description: Returns the persistent store for testing.

methods.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::GetReportingServiceForTesting
methods.description: Returns the reporting service for testing.
